mainEntity.name: How much does a BMW X3 30d engine replacement cost in the UK?

acceptedAnswer.text: A BMW X3 30d rebuilt engine typically costs £1,800-£5,500 supply-only, with N57D30B and B57D30A units at the higher end and M57D30 engines starting lower. Supply & fit adds £500-£1,200 depending on the specialist and your location. M57D30 (E83, 2003-2010): £1,800-£3,200 supply-only. N57D30A (F25, 2010-2014): £2,200-£4,200 supply-only. N57D30B (F25 LCI, 2014-2017): £2,400-£4,500 supply-only. B57D30A (G01, 2017-present): £3,200-£5,500 supply-only. Used engines start from £1,200 supply-only. Main dealer replacement costs 40-60% more than specialist prices.

mainEntity.name: Is the BMW X3 30d timing chain a common failure point?

acceptedAnswer.text: No - the straight-six diesel is significantly more reliable than the N47 four-cylinder. The M57 is legendary for durability, and the N57/B57 are also robust. Timing chain failure is rare on the 3.0d, but tensioner wear can occur at very high mileage (150,000+ miles). M57 timing chain can last 200,000+ miles with proper oil changes. N57/B57 timing chains are durable but tensioner wear is possible. Rattling on cold start is the primary warning sign. Preventative chain replacement costs £1,400-£2,200 at a specialist. Far fewer timing chain issues than the 2.0d N47 engine.

mainEntity.name: What is the most reliable BMW X3 30d engine - M57, N57 or B57?

acceptedAnswer.text: The M57D30 (E83, 2003-2010) is widely regarded as BMW's most durable diesel engine - capable of 200,000+ miles with proper maintenance. The B57D30A (G01, 2017-present) is the most refined and efficient, while the N57 (F25) offers the best power-to-weight ratio but has more complexity. M57D30 - bulletproof, 200k+ miles, simple maintenance. N57D30 - more power (258-286hp) but EGR cooler and injector concerns. B57D30A - modern, efficient, 48V MHEV, but DPF-sensitive. All three are excellent engines - the N57 just needs more careful maintenance.

mainEntity.name: What causes BMW X3 30d EGR cooler failure on N57 and B57 engines?

acceptedAnswer.text: The EGR cooler develops internal cracks due to thermal cycling, allowing coolant to leak into the exhaust system. BMW issued service bulletins addressing this concern. Symptoms include coolant loss, white exhaust smoke, and in severe cases, engine hydrolock. Coolant escapes from defective cooler into exhaust or combustion chambers. Combined with soot creates risk of hydrolock if coolant enters cylinders. Affects N57 and B57 diesel engines across BMW's range. BMW used an improved cooler from a different supplier from 2022.

mainEntity.name: Is it worth replacing the engine on a high-mileage BMW X3 30d?

acceptedAnswer.text: On an E83 X3 30d (2003-2010) worth £3,000-£7,000, a £3,800-£5,800 rebuilt engine often makes sense if the car is otherwise sound. On F25 and G01 models, replacement is almost always worthwhile given the strong residual values of the straight-six diesel. E83 X3 30d (2003-2010): borderline - specialist rebuild only. F25 X3 30d (2010-2017): usually worth replacing - car worth £6,000-£18,000. G01 X3 30d (2017-present): absolutely worth replacing - high residual value. Rebuilt engine includes 12-month warranty and upgraded components. Specialist replacement costs half what a main dealer charges.

mainEntity.name: What is the labour cost to replace a BMW X3 30d engine?

acceptedAnswer.text: Specialist labour for BMW X3 30d engine replacement typically costs £500-£1,200, covering 10-16 hours of work. Main dealers charge £1,500-£2,500 for the same job. Independent BMW specialist: £60-£80 per hour, 10-16 hours total. Main dealer: £150-£250 per hour, same labour time. Straight-six engine access requires more time than four-cylinder. Supply & fit packages typically add £500-£1,200 to engine price.

historyTimeline.h2: BMW X3 30d - Engine History & Specs at a Glance
historyTimeline.intro: The BMW X3 30d badge represents the pinnacle of diesel engineering across three generations of X3. From the bulletproof M57 in the E83 (2003-2010) to the twin-turbo N57 in the F25 (2010-2017) and the refined B57 in the G01 (2017-present), the 30d has always delivered the smooth power, effortless torque and legendary durability of BMW's straight-six diesel architecture - making it the choice for high-mileage drivers and towing users alike.

milestones.description: E83 generation launches with M57D30, 204hp, 410Nm, naturally aspirated (later turbocharged)
E83 LCI updates M57D30 to 218hp, 500Nm with variable geometry turbo
F25 generation launches with N57D30A, 258hp, 560Nm, twin-turbocharged
F25 LCI introduces N57D30B, 286hp, 600Nm, with improved injectors and emissions hardware
G01 generation launches with B57D30A, 265hp, 620Nm, featuring 48V mild hybrid on later models
G01 LCI updates B57D30A with 48V MHEV system for improved efficiency and reduced lag

historyTimeline.closingNote: Every engine fitted to the BMW X3 30d is covered below, with UK rebuilt pricing and known failure points.

commonProblems.h2: BMW X3 30d Engine Problems - Repair Cost vs Replacement
commonProblems.h3: The BMW X3 30d's straight-six diesel reputation is built on durability - but even the best engines have their weak points. The M57 is legendary for longevity, the N57 adds power with complexity, and the B57 brings modern efficiency with new failure modes. Every rebuilt engine supplied through Engines Market includes upgraded components addressing the original failure point - plus a minimum 12-month unlimited-mileage warranty. Below we break down the most common X3 30d failures, what genuine repair costs look like, and when a rebuilt engine is the smarter financial decision.

problems.h4: BMW X3 30d Timing Chain Wear - Rare on the Straight-Six, But Not Impossible
problems.affectedModels: BMW X3 E83 3.0d, F25 xDrive30d, G01 xDrive30d (M57D30, N57D30A/B, B57D30A)
problems.rootCause: Unlike the notorious N47 four-cylinder diesel, the straight-six M57 and N57 engines do not suffer from the same catastrophic timing chain failure rates. However, timing chain tensioner wear can occur at very high mileage, particularly if oil changes have been neglected. The chain setup is the same as the 2.0d but failure is rare on the 3.0d.

repairOptions.whatItInvolves: Replace tensioner only - addresses rattle without full chain replacement
repairOptions.longevity: Viable if caught early, before chain has stretched

repairOptions.tier: Major - Full Timing Chain Kit Replacement
repairOptions.whatItInvolves: Replace chain, guides, tensioner, sprockets - engine remains in car
repairOptions.longevity: Prevents failure on high-mileage units - adds 80k+ miles

repairOptions.whatItInvolves: Supply of rebuilt unit with new timing components, fitted, tested, 12-month warranty
repairOptions.longevity: Required if chain has jumped timing or caused valve damage

problems.vehicleValueCheck: A typical BMW X3 30d is worth £4,000-£25,000 depending on age and mileage. A timing chain tensioner replacement at £500-£800 is a minor expense on any 30d. Full chain kit replacement at £1,400-£2,200 is excellent value on a £10,000+ car. Full engine replacement is rarely needed on the straight-six unless the chain has been completely neglected.
problems.recommendation: Listen for rattling on cold start-up - if you hear it, have a specialist inspect the timing chain tensioner immediately. The straight-six is far more resilient than the N47, but tensioner wear can still cause expensive damage if ignored. On high-mileage M57 and N57 engines, consider preventative chain replacement at 150,000 miles as scheduled maintenance.
problems.cta: -> Compare rebuilt BMW X3 30d engine prices from UK specialists

problems.h4: BMW X3 30d EGR Cooler Failure - The Most Common N57 & B57 Weakness
problems.affectedModels: BMW X3 F25 xDrive30d, G01 xDrive30d (N57D30A/B, B57D30A)
problems.rootCause: The EGR cooler can develop internal cracks due to thermal cycling, allowing coolant to leak into the exhaust system. In severe cases, coolant can enter the combustion chambers, causing hydraulic lock (hydrolock) and bent connecting rods.

repairOptions.whatItInvolves: Replace EGR cooler, flush cooling system, reset adaptations
repairOptions.longevity: Full fix if caught before coolant enters cylinders

repairOptions.whatItInvolves: EGR cooler replacement plus cylinder head removal, inspection, new head gasket
repairOptions.longevity: Viable if no bent rods confirmed

repairOptions.whatItInvolves: Supply of rebuilt unit with revised EGR cooler, fitted, tested, 12-month warranty

problems.vehicleValueCheck: EGR cooler replacement at £550-£850 is a minor expense on any X3 30d. Full engine replacement is rarely needed unless the issue has been ignored.
problems.recommendation: Check if your X3 30d has outstanding EGR cooler recall work. If you notice coolant loss, white exhaust smoke, or a burning smell, have a specialist inspect the EGR cooler immediately. A £550-£850 cooler replacement is cheap insurance against a £4,000+ engine rebuild.
problems.cta: -> Get quotes for BMW X3 30d EGR cooler repair and replacement

problems.h4: BMW X3 30d Turbocharger Failure - Loss of Boost & Whining Noise
problems.affectedModels: BMW X3 E83 3.0d, F25 xDrive30d, G01 xDrive30d (M57D30, N57D30A/B, B57D30A)
problems.rootCause: Turbocharger bearings wear over high mileage, allowing the compressor wheel to contact the housing. On variable geometry turbos (N57/B57), the unison ring can seize due to carbon build-up. Symptoms include loss of power, excessive smoke, and a high-pitched whining noise.

repairOptions.whatItInvolves: Remove turbo, replace CHRA cartridge, balance, new gaskets, oil flush
repairOptions.longevity: Viable if caught before debris enters oil system

repairOptions.whatItInvolves: Replace with fully reconditioned turbo unit, new oil feed pipes, full flush
Supply of rebuilt unit with new turbo, full oil system flush, fitted, tested, 12-month warranty
repairOptions.longevity: Required if turbo debris has circulated through engine

problems.vehicleValueCheck: Turbo cartridge replacement at £1,000-£1,600 is cost-effective on any X3 30d. Full engine replacement is only needed if the turbo has disintegrated.
problems.recommendation: If you hear a whining noise or experience loss of power, stop driving and have a specialist inspect the turbo immediately. A £1,000-£1,600 turbo replacement is far cheaper than a £4,000+ engine rebuild. On the M57, turbo failure is rarely an engine-killer if caught early.
problems.cta: -> Compare BMW X3 30d turbo replacement and engine repair costs

problems.h4: BMW X3 30d DPF & Injector Failure - Urban Driving Kills Diesel Engines
problems.affectedModels: BMW X3 F25 xDrive30d, G01 xDrive30d (N57D30A/B, B57D30A)
problems.rootCause: Urban driving cycles prevent active DPF regeneration, causing soot accumulation. Piezo injectors on the N57 can develop internal leakage, unburned fuel washes cylinder walls, and can cause piston damage in extreme cases.

repairOptions.whatItInvolves: Forced regeneration, DPF cleaning, EGR valve service
Diagnose failed injector, replace with OEM or refurbished unit, code to ECU
Replace all six injectors, coding, fuel filter, oil change
repairOptions.longevity: Recommended if one fails beyond 100k miles

repairOptions.whatItInvolves: Supply of rebuilt unit with new injectors and DPF, fitted, tested, 12-month warranty
repairOptions.longevity: Required if injector failure has caused piston damage

problems.vehicleValueCheck: A £350-£600 DPF clean is worthwhile on any X3 30d. Injector replacement at £450-£700 per injector is cost-effective. Full set replacement at £1,400-£2,200 makes sense on cars over 100k miles.
problems.recommendation: If you only drive short urban trips, take your X3 30d on a 30-minute motorway run every few weeks to allow DPF regeneration. If the engine idles roughly or smokes excessively, have the injectors tested immediately. On N57 engines over 100k miles, consider replacing all six injectors preventatively if one fails.
problems.cta: -> Compare BMW X3 30d DPF and injector repair costs

finalCta.h4: Don't Let Engine Failure Write Off Your BMW X3 30d
finalCta.paragraph: The failures above account for the majority of BMW X3 30d engine replacement enquiries we see - EGR cooler failure on N57 and B57 units, turbocharger wear, and injector/DPF issues. The M57 remains the benchmark for diesel durability, but even the legendary straight-six needs proper maintenance.
